sentences.en: They succeeded in destroying the 'queens' of the bugger race, effectively dooming them.

sentences.en: Their policy seems to consist entirely of sitting on their fat backsides doing absolutely bugger all in response to enquiries from prospective customers.

sentences.en: Sorry to hear about your brush with Dundee's criminal fraternity; I'm sure they'll get the bugger eventually.

sentences.en: I think Ill market my idea of NVQs you can achieve by doing bugger all!

sentences.en: I was then informed not to be a cheeky bugger.
